_about: Historical FX market events for the DCA capital-survival replay (claude code changed: 2026-10-21 — new). Facts below are as reported by the cited sources (retrieved 2026-10-21). Annotation only: the replay never reads this file when making trading decisions, and a coincidence of an event with a loss is not proof that the event caused it.

events.title: Japan intervenes to support the yen (first time since 1998)
events.description: Japan's authorities bought yen for the first time since 1998, shortly after the BoJ kept ultra-low rates; USD/JPY reversed from ~145 to ~141.

events.title: UK 'mini-budget' and sterling record low
events.description: Chancellor Kwarteng announced ~GBP 45bn of unfunded tax cuts on 23 Sep 2022; sterling fell to a record low near $1.035 in early Asian trade on 26 Sep 2022 and gilt yields jumped.

events.title: BoJ unexpectedly widens the yield-curve-control band to +/-0.5 %
events.description: The BoJ kept rates at -0.1 % but widened the 10-year yield band from +/-0.25 to +/-0.50 points; the yen rose nearly 4 % against the dollar.

events.title: Silicon Valley Bank failure and March 2023 banking turmoil
events.description: California's regulator closed SVB on 10 Mar 2023 and appointed the FDIC as receiver — the largest US bank failure since 2008.

events.title: BoJ ends negative interest rates
events.description: First BoJ hike in 17 years (to 0-0.1 %), end of yield-curve control; widely expected, the yen weakened slightly.

events.title: Japan yen-buying intervention (record JPY 5.92trn on 29 Apr, 3.87trn on 1 May 2024)
events.description: USD/JPY touched ~160 on 29 Apr 2024; the MoF later confirmed JPY 5,918.5bn on 29 Apr and 3,870.0bn on 1 May.

events.title: BoJ hike to 0.25 % and the yen carry-trade unwind (Nikkei -12.4 % on 5 Aug 2024)
events.description: BoJ raised its policy rate to ~0.25 % on 31 Jul 2024; carry trades unwound, USD/JPY fell from ~162 (early July) to ~141.7 on 5 Aug, when the Nikkei closed down 12.4 % amid weak US jobs data.

events.title: US 'Liberation Day' tariffs and global risk-off
events.description: Announced tariffs (10 % baseline plus country rates) triggered the largest two-day US stock loss on record; the yen acted as a safe haven; pressure eased from 9 Apr with a 90-day pause.

events.title: Yen rebounds on hawkish BoJ guidance (market commentary)
events.description: Commerzbank commentary: USD/JPY fell >1 % to ~158.20 as markets priced a September BoJ hike; intervention ('rate check') was speculated but not confirmed. Lower-confidence source class: broker/bank commentary, not an official release.
